entries.title: No controlled technical data is released to a foreign person without a licence or a cited exception, and the check binds at role grant rather than at read
Controlled technical data never appears in logs, telemetry, support bundles or model context
Export records are append-only: the initial image is preserved and every change records who made it and when
A screening hit is never auto-cleared; screening-service failure is treated as a hit, never as a pass
No change introduces a path that circumvents an export control, whatever its stated purpose
The encryption carve-out holds only when every precondition holds, including that the means of decryption are withheld from any third party
Every controlled artifact carries a recorded ECCN classification
A licence exception is cited by paragraph, never asserted in the abstract
The foreign direct product determination is recorded for covered items
End-use and end-user knowledge checks are documented for covered end uses
Geofencing is enforced at the authorisation layer, not in the client
Entity List footnote chains are evaluated, not just the direct party
Export records are retained for five years and are not disposed of while an agency request stands
The architecture resolves conflicting cross-border government-access obligations at design time, because no runtime resolution exists
A regulatory or litigation hold overrides every deletion path, including erasure requests
Regulated records are stored in the declared jurisdiction
Cross-border transfer carries a recorded lawful basis
Important-data classification is applied before export assessment
Data lineage records the funding provenance of the technology it describes
Sub-processor regions are declared and verified
No change suppresses or delays an equipment safety interlock signal
Recipe transfer messages are authenticated and logged before the equipment acts on them
Event report routing is preserved across a release
Reply timers stay within their configured bounds
Alarm reports are delivered within their declared budget
Control-state transitions are exercised by test before release
Message ordering is preserved under load
Unparsed equipment replies are quarantined, never silently discarded
Collection-event identifiers are stable across a release unless amended
Spooling is enabled so that offline periods do not lose event reports
Every changed monitoring path declares a latency budget and its context
Measured p99.9 latency stays within the declared budget
Latency measurement corrects for coordinated omission
No blocking operation is introduced on a monitoring hot path
Load conditions are declared alongside every latency result
Histogram evidence is retained with the result, not just a summary statistic
Priority-inversion protection is present where a real-time path shares a lock
Work-in-progress status is never altered retroactively
Metrology and recipe-execution records are never overwritten in place
A correction is recorded as a new entry carrying its own attribution
Metrology results are bound to lot and wafer identity in one transaction
The record hash chain survives a migration
Lot genealogy is reconstructable from the records alone
Record timestamps come from a trusted monotonic source
Recipe parameters are never written to logs, caches, telemetry labels or support bundles in plaintext
Recipe parameters never enter a model prompt or fine-tuning context
Recipes are encrypted at rest and in transit
Debug and support modes redact process parameters
Recipe access is scoped to the named process owner
A recipe diff is reviewed by two named engineers
Recipe payload caches are bounded and encrypted
No release artifact is deployed to a fab network without a provenance attestation verified against the expected builder identity
The provenance subject digest matches the artifact actually distributed
Signing certificates come from a trusted OIDC issuer set
Reusable workflows and actions are pinned to a commit digest and drawn from a trusted set
Dependencies resolve from the declared internal registry first
Dependencies are pinned to an immutable digest, never a floating range
Every release publishes a signed SBOM that matches the approved baseline
Component integrity drift — a changed hash under an unchanged version — blocks the merge
No dependency is introduced carrying a known vulnerability above the CVSS threshold
Dependency licences stay on the allowlist
The pipeline denies privileged credentials to untrusted code and sanitises untrusted metadata before use
AI agents never modify equipment-control or interlock code paths
AI agents never modify export-control enforcement logic
Every imported package is verified to exist in the registry before merge
Agent-authored code executes only inside a sandboxed runner
Agent code calls only allowlisted external hosts
API contract tests pass against the pinned specification on every changed interface
Agent instructions derived from untrusted text are treated as tainted input
An agent may not disable or weaken a failing compliance test
Shared state introduced on the ingest path declares its synchronisation
Removing or weakening a synchronisation primitive requires an enumerated expected-outcome set
Telemetry buffers are bounded
Every exit path releases its resources
Changed translation units are clean under a race detector
A concurrency defect is classified before it is dispositioned
Where an analysis tool is known to be unsound for the property, that unsoundness is declared
Controlled technical data in transit never uses a deprecated protocol version or cipher
Cipher suites stay on the current allowlist
A configuration level is declared with its compatibility justification
Primitives pass their known-answer tests, which is not the same as holding a validation certificate
Verifiers reject invalid signatures, invalid curve points and malformed ciphertexts
Nonce construction is safe under concurrency
All new database access uses parameterised queries
Lot and wafer identifiers are validated against an allowlist
Operator notes are output-encoded before render
No endpoint reaches command execution on a user-supplied path
Deserialisation is restricted to known types
Changed endpoints are fuzzed before release
Error responses omit internal identifiers and stack traces
A claimed control names the NIST control identifier it maps to
The supply-chain risk management plan is updated after a covered change
The CUI handling boundary is documented for every changed component
Covered expansion transactions are notified regardless of any claimed exception
A secure software development practice is cited for each control claim
Assessment evidence is attached to every claimed control
No configuration removes the affected party's path to contest an automated decision
No system exploits vulnerabilities of a person, and no untargeted biometric scraping is enabled
The constitution declares whether any party holds contest standing adverse to grants
Constitutional parameters change only by legislative enactment
Reporter output never reaches the adjudication input path
The audit register is disjoint from the precedent store and is never read by resolve
Every arrival that is not charged leaves exactly one docket entry
ITAR technical data is never released to a foreign person and lives only inside the segregated defence enclave; there is no de minimis threshold, no group-A carve-out and no risk acceptance
Access to or transfer of a defence article or ITAR technical data proceeds only while DDTC registration is current and a licence or a section-cited exemption is bound into the grant

ITAR technical data is never stored or transmitted outside the authorised boundary unless every condition of the encryption carve-out holds: end-to-end encryption with a validated module, no storage in a proscribed country or Russia, and no decryption means held by a third party

A jurisdiction determination — USML category or CCL classification — is recorded for every defence-adjacent artifact before ingest, and an unresolved item is treated as ITAR until a determination says otherwise

Counterparty screening against the SDN and consolidated sanctions lists, with fifty-percent ownership aggregation, is never bypassed for any counterparty class, and blocked-property handling is not configurable
A request to take a boycott-related action is never acted on and never dropped from the quarterly report, whether it arrives in a purchase order, a letter of credit or a portal form
Before covered technology or data is shared with a joint-venture or investee party, the outbound-investment and CFIUS determinations are recorded against the counterparty and the transaction
Conflict-minerals inquiry data — smelter and refiner identity and country of origin — is collected from suppliers, retained and carried on the component record that feeds the annual Form SD
Forced-labour screening of suppliers and their upstream sources is never disabled or downgraded, and a match against the UFLPA Entity List blocks receipt until the presumption is rebutted
Counterfeit-part avoidance records — inspection result, distributor authorisation status and suspect-part disposition — are recorded per lot and never skipped for expedite
A broker-sourced or grey-market lot is quarantined until its provenance chain is verified, and the grey-market flag on the genealogy record is cleared only by a recorded disposition
Hazardous-gas monitoring alarms are never suppressed, filtered, rate-limited or re-thresholded by software, and reach the life-safety panel before any analytics path
Lockout/tagout, emergency-off and interlock states are read-only to software: no host command, status transformation or configuration can override, mask or reset them
Effluent, emissions and chemical-reporting pipelines never drop, round or alter a monitoring result between measurement and the reported value, and a reporting job is never disabled by configuration
ESD-monitor and cleanroom environmental telemetry is retained at native resolution for the declared period, and any change to sampling or aggregation is recorded with an effective date
A process, recipe or material change is classified and a customer change notice issued before the first affected lot is exposed, and the release gate enforces the customer's notice period
Every nonconformance opens a corrective-action record; root cause and verification of effectiveness are recorded, and closure carries a named owner
An advanced-process-control or run-to-run controller model is promoted to production only after validation on held-out lots, with a recorded version on lot history and a tested rollback path
Reticle and photomask revisions are bound to the lot and recipe record, traceable to an approved engineering change, and a retired revision cannot be dispatched to a tool
The fab-floor tool network is a distinct security zone: traffic to enterprise or cloud crosses only a declared conduit, and no change bridges the zones or opens a boundary rule to any source
Vendor remote access to equipment is brokered through a jump host, approved per session by a named owner, recorded, time-boxed and scoped to the named tool
Tool firmware and equipment software updates carry vendor-signed provenance verified before install, are staged on a non-production tool first, and are recorded on the equipment record
Equipment time comes from an authenticated source; clock drift on the tool network is monitored and alarmed, and no unauthenticated time server is added to an equipment path
Ship fast or test fully: ship with at most one open non-security checklist item, with a remediation ticket
Cost or quality: cost cuts may not remove a documented quality control
Customer first: customer-visible latency regressions need a stated customer benefit
Accessibility beyond law: never remove an existing accessibility feature without a token from the accessibility lead
House style for alternative text and messages
Documentation currency: docs updated with the change
